references.text: The total number of men who were mustered was 603,550, the same figure given here in the final summary of the census.
Moses notes that the people numbered 600,000 foot soldiers, confirming the large number of Israelites who wandered in the wilderness.
At the exodus from Egypt there were about 600,000 men on foot, which corresponds with the census in Numbers.
In the counting of the silver from the ransom money there were 603,550 men, the same number as in this muster.
The second census 40 years later showed 601,730 men, which can be compared with the first count here.
Jacob's house that came to Egypt was only 70 people, showing the enormous growth to over 600,000 fighting men.
